newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World PCS sets terms on HK$1.5 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: New World PCS sets terms on HK$1.5 bln loan.

text.p: New World PCS Ltd plans to launch its HK$1.5 billion loan facility into general syndication on February 3, bankers said on Tuesday.
They said New World Development Co will guarantee 85 percent of the loan, while Thailand's Total Access Communications PCL will guarantee the remaining 15 percent.
The amortising loan has a final maturity of eight years with a put option in year five. It will pay a margin of 75 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is expected to be in the mid-80s, bankers said.
Proceeds will be used for the company's development of the next generation of mobile communications.
Arrangers are Deutsche Bank Hong Kong, Hang Seng Bank and BNP Hong Kong.
New World Develpment Co is a major Hong Kong blue-chip company.
Total Access is the second-largest mobile phone operator in Thailand. The company said last week it expects 1996 net profit to grow by 36 percent from 1995's 1.9 billion baht.
